title: Bioluminescent Threshold
description: A dense horizontal band of overlapping translucent circles in muted dark tones occupies the upper half against a black background. The lower half consists of a vibrant field of multicolored overlapping circles in warm oranges, yellows, teals and purples, creating a distinct visual divide between the two zones.
prompt: abstract painting featuring two distinct horizontal registers of overlapping translucent circles, upper section dark muted tones of grey, black, teal and subtle iridescent highlights on pure black background, lower section vibrant field of overlapping circles in saturated orange, yellow, teal, purple and red, high contrast between the dark upper band and luminous colorful lower band, soft bokeh-like texture throughout, painterly digital art style
